They were led by head coach [[Tad Boyle]] in his fourteenth season at Colorado. The Buffaloes played their home games at [[CU Events Center]] in [[Boulder, Colorado]] in their last season as members of the [[Pac-12 Conference]] before they rejoined the [[Big 12 Conference]] in the 2024–25 season.{{Cite web|date=2023-08-05|title=Arizona, Arizona State, Utah join Big 12: Programs follow Colorado departing Pac-12 before 2024 season|url=https://www.cbssports.com/college-football/news/arizona-arizona-state-utah-join-big-12-programs-follow-colorado-departing-pac-12-before-2024-season/|access-date=2023-08-05|website=CBSSports.com|language=en}} Following their victory over [[2023–24 Oregon State Beavers men's basketball team|Oregon State]] on March 9, 2024, the Buffaloes finished the regular season with 22 wins, the most regular-season wins in program history.{{cite news |last=Woelk |first=Neill |access-date=January 8, 2025|title=Buffs Top OSU For Sixth Straight Win |url=https://cubuffs.com/news/2024/3/9/mens-basketball-buffs-win-at-oregon-state-to-stretch-streak-to-six |publisher=University of Colorado Athletics |date=March 9, 2024}} They defeated [[2023–24 Utah Utes men's basketball team|Utah]] in the quarterfinals and [[2023–24 Washington State Cougars men's basketball team|Washington State]] in the semifinals of the [[2024 Pac-12 Conference men's basketball tournament|Pac-12 tournament]] before falling to [[2023–24 Oregon Ducks men's basketball team|Oregon]] in the Pac-12 championship game. Colorado returned to the NCAA tournament for the first time since [[2021 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|2021]] where they defeated [[2023–24 Boise State Broncos men's basketball team|Boise State]], 60–53, in the First Four and [[2023–24 Florida Gators men's basketball team|Florida]], 102–100, in the first round before losing to [[2023–24 Marquette Golden Eagles men's basketball team|Marquette]], 81–77, in the second round.{{cite news |last=Woelk |first=Neill |access-date=January 8, 2025|title=Buffs Rally To Top Boise State In NCAA Opener |url=https://cubuffs.com/news/2024/3/20/mens-basketball-buffs-vs-boise |publisher=University of Colorado Athletics |date=March 20, 2024}}{{cite news |last=Woelk |first=Neill |access-date=January 8, 2025|title=Buffs Top Florida At Buzzer To Advance In NCAA Tournament |url=https://cubuffs.com/news/2024/3/22/mens-basketball-buffs-vs-florida |publisher=University of Colorado Athletics |date=March 22, 2024}}{{cite news |last=Woelk |first=Neill |access-date=January 8, 2025|title=Buffs Fall To Marquette In NCAA Tournament Second Round |url=https://cubuffs.com/news/2024/3/24/mens-basketball-buffs-vs-marquette |publisher=University of Colorado Athletics |date=March 24, 2024}} The Buffaloes' defeat of Boise State and Florida gave Colorado their most victories in program history. ==Previous season== The Buffaloes finished the season 18–17, 8–12 in [[2022–23 Pac-12 Conference men's basketball season|Pac-12 play]]. They defeated [[2022–23 Washington Huskies men's basketball team|Washington]] in the first round of the [[2023 Pac-12 Conference men's basketball tournament|Pac-12 tournament]] before losing in the quarterfinals to [[2022–23 UCLA Bruins men's basketball team|UCLA]].{{cite news |last=Woelk |first=Neill |access-date=January 8, 2025|title=Buffs Fall To UCLA In Pac-12 Quarterfinal |url=https://cubuffs.com/news/2023/3/9/mens-basketball-buffs-fall-to-ucla-in-pac-12-quarterfinal.aspx |publisher=University of Colorado Athletics |date=March 9, 2023}} They received an at-large bid to the [[2023 National Invitation Tournament|National Invitation Tournament]] where they defeated [[2022–23 Seton Hall Pirates men's basketball team|Seton Hall]] in the first round before losing to [[2022–23 Utah Valley Wolverines men's basketball team|Utah Valley]] in the second round.{{cite news |last=Woelk |first=Neill |access-date=January 8, 2025|title=Buffs Fall To Utah Valley In Second Round Of NIT |url=https://cubuffs.com/news/2023/3/19/mens-basketball-buffs-vs-uvu.aspx |publisher=University of Colorado Athletics |date=March 19, 2023}} ==Off-season== ===Departures=== {| class="wikitable sortable" style="font-size:100%;" border="1" !
